notes: createSlotFromZIP's own doc comment (lines 1002-1006) states plainly: 'no structural validation is enforced here -- if the ZIP is malformed the slot will be stored but activation will fail.' MSC 1 accepts any bytes at import time and defers all risk to whenever the slot is later activated (extracted via /usr/bin/unzip -o with no path checks -- see world-archive-safety's activation-time cases, which are where Phase 6 corrects this under D-006 rather than reproducing it: MSC 1's shell-based extraction has no defense against zip-slip, absolute paths, or symlink entries, and preserving that as baseline behavior would be preserving a security bug, not a contract). This fixture pins only the import-time behavior MSC 1 actually has today (verbatim copy, best-effort level-name/seed inference) -- the correction lives in the world-archive-safety fixtures, applied uniformly at every extraction point rather than duplicated here.
